suggestions.quote: Parents and children can book back to back.
suggestions.why: The ficha says families can "often" book back to back, and this sentence drops the hedge, though the next sentence ("we will look for back-to-back times") restores it.
suggestions.fix: Write "Parents and children can often book back to back."

suggestions.quote: The first visit for a child is $60.
suggestions.why: The $60 price matches the ficha, but it sits in the family-booking section of a post about adult checkups and may confuse readers about which visit it covers.
suggestions.fix: Move it to a clearly labelled children's visit sentence or remove it from this adult-focused post.
